addictionPotential: 高度成瘾且滥用潜力高。
toxicities: 与酒精或阿片等抑制剂混用可能致命。
summary: 一种噻吡二氮卓类抗焦虑药。作用类似苯二氮卓。缓解焦虑、镇静并带轻度欣快。高剂量可导致记忆缺失。用户常强迫性反复补服导致断片。可见于压片药、地下药片工坊或粉末形式。
effectsSummary: Etizolam has anxiolytic, sedative, muscle relaxant and sleep-inducing effects. It is a thienodiazepine, structurally similar to benzodiazepines.
dosageRemark: Etizolam is potent. Effects can last 4-6 hours. Tolerance develops quickly.
generalRisks: Drowsiness, dizziness, impaired coordination, memory impairment. Risk of dependence with regular use. Dangerous when mixed with other depressants.
longtermRisks: Regular use leads to dependence. Withdrawal symptoms include anxiety, insomnia, and seizures.
saferUse: 如果在线购买，实际成分可能与标识不同。
不要依赖他人的剂量信息。
苯二氮䓬类药物的伪造品非常常见。
